home.title: Mizani — Advocates Complaints Commission
home.tagline: File a complaint against an advocate and follow it to resolution.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your mobile number. We will send you a 6-digit code by SMS.
login.codeSent: We sent a code to your phone. It expires in 10 minutes.

errors.invalid_phone: Enter a valid Kenyan mobile number, e.g. 0712 345 678.
errors.rate_limited: Too many codes requested. Please wait 10 minutes and try again.
errors.invalid_code: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the SMS or request a new code.

myCases.title: My cases
myCases.empty: You have not filed any complaints yet.

file.title: File a complaint
file.intro: Tell us about the advocate and what happened. You will get a case number and a PIN to track your complaint.
file.advocateHint: Start typing to search the roll of advocates. If you cannot find them, type the name as you know it.
file.evidenceHint: Up to 5 files: PDF, JPG or PNG, 10 MB each.
file.consent: I consent to the Advocates Complaints Commission processing my personal data to handle this complaint, under the Data Protection Act, 2019.

errors.invalid_input: Please fix the following and submit again:
errors.too_many_files: You can attach at most 5 files.
errors.file_too_large: Each file must be 10 MB or smaller.
errors.file_type: Only PDF, JPG and PNG files are accepted.
errors.not_signed_in: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.server: Something went wrong and your complaint was not filed. Please try again.

fieldErrors.advocateId: Choose the advocate again from the list.
fieldErrors.consentDataProcessing: You must give consent to continue.

success.title: Complaint received
success.body: We have sent these details to your phone by SMS.
success.pinWarning: Keep this PIN private. You need it with your case number to check status by USSD or on the status page.

status.title: Check case status
status.intro: Enter your case number and the PIN you received when you filed. You can also dial the ACC USSD code from any phone.

errors.bad_case_number: Enter the case number as shown on your slip or SMS, e.g. ACC/2026/000123.
errors.invalid: Case number and PIN do not match. Please check and try again.
errors.locked: Too many wrong attempts for this case. Try again in 1 hour.
